papers.title: Layered abstraction in emblematic gesture processing: evidence from a multilevel priming paradigm and drift-diffusion model.
papers.reason: Uses hierarchical drift-diffusion modelling of human evidence accumulation and conflict resolution, though the target domain is gesture comprehension rather than core planning, working memory, or attention.

papers.title: Females with Epilepsy Show Menstrual Cycle-linked Alterations in Sensory Induced Plasticity.
papers.reason: Reports EEG and generative modelling of sensory plasticity in epilepsy, but it is not meaningfully focused on executive function, cognitive assessment, or cognitive control.

papers.title: Working memory capacity moderates stress-related drinking in alcohol use disorder: An intensive one-year ecological assessment study.
papers.reason: Substantially examines working memory capacity as a moderator of real-world clinical behaviour in alcohol use disorder, with smartphone assessment and structural brain imaging relevance.

papers.title: Cognitive capacity in subjective cognitive decline: Insights from electrophysiological markers and dual-task performance.
papers.reason: Directly combines EEG and dual-task working-memory performance to distinguish subjective cognitive decline from controls, closely matching early cognitive impairment assessment interests.

papers.title: Atypical delusional misidentification with alternating impostors in a single body: a case report.
papers.reason: A psychiatric case report on delusional misidentification has no clear connection to modelling or assessing executive function.

papers.title: Exploratory evaluation of electroencephalogram-derived features for classification of mild cognitive impairment in two independent datasets.
papers.reason: Evaluates EEG-derived features for classifying MCI versus controls across datasets, making it relevant to digital biomarker development for early cognitive impairment despite lacking executive-function tasks.
